args.stdin:
WITH base_line AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku AS product_sku, pv.record_path AS record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pv.brand)) = 'ajax'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.series)) = 'eco'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.model)) = 'classic 25c-dxe'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(pv.product_name)) LIKE '%cleaning liquid%'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT bl.product_sku AS product_sku, bl.record_path AS record_path
  FROM base_line bl
  WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p
      WHERE p.product_sku = bl.product_sku
        AND REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(p.property_key)), ' ', '_') IN ('cleaner_type','cleaner_kind','cleaning_type','type')
        AND LOWER(TRIM(p.property_value_text)) = 'floor cleaner'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p
      WHERE p.product_sku = bl.product_sku
        AND REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(p.property_key)), ' ', '_') IN ('fragrance','fragrance_type','scent','smell')
        AND LOWER(TRIM(p.property_value_text)) = 'fresh'
    )
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combined) AS combined_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT product_sku FROM combined ORDER BY product_sku LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT product_sku FROM base_line ORDER BY product_sku LIMIT 1)) AS checked_sku,
  COALESCE((SELECT record_path FROM combined ORDER BY product_sku LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT record_path FROM base_line ORDER BY product_sku LIMIT 1)) AS record_path;

combined_present.message: <YES> — base product exists and the claimed floor-cleaner+fresh combination is present; checked SKU {checked_sku}.

combined_absent.message: <NO> — base product exists but the claimed floor-cleaner+fresh combination is absent; checked SKU {checked_sku}.
